composition_sum.interpretation: perturbed wt_percent compositions renormalize to the declared total with nonnegative weights

coverage_accounting.interpretation: applied factors <= covered rows; uncovered rows named by index (zero-uncertainty rows are not claimed covered)

flux_linear.interpretation: response linear in flux normalization: sample = nominal x factor within 1e-6

seed_reproducibility.interpretation: fixed seed reproduces per-sample outputs; not convergence evidence

zero_variance.interpretation: zero declared std -> zero spread, samples identical to nominal
